'''Hank''' (Japanese: '''ヒヨシ''' ''Hiyoshi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG183|Aipom and Circumstance!]]''.

Hank, along with many other villagers, were competing in a contest to see who the next king would be; whoever had the crown in their hands by sunset would be the king for a year. However, because of interference by [[Ash's Aipom]], Hank decided to help {{Ash}} in order to find Aipom and the crown that she had stolen.

Even though Hank often had great ideas, such as using his {{p|Nosepass}} to navigate through the mountains, he had a problem with speaking his mind at times. Later, when they found Aipom with the crown stuck on her head, Hank came up with another idea, which involved feeding Aipom a sour [[Belue Berry]] in order to get the crown off. By sunset, he was the one with the crown in his hands and was named King for a Year. Ash said that he should have no problem being king because he always came up with great plans.
